svg.title: DNS Tapir Data Flow
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing DNS Tapir data flow from Resolver and EDM at the Edge, through Core MQTT, MQTT bridge, NATS analyzers, observation encoding, downbound MQTT, POP policy processing, RPZ output, and resolver enforcement. Side flows show EDM histogram uploads to aggrec and local pseudonymised session Parquet files.
svg.text: Edge collection, Core event analysis, southbound policy delivery, and resolver enforcement
Ingress, validation, analysis, aggregate reception, and southbound encoding

g.text: events/up/<kid>/new_qname, where <kid> is the signing JWK key id
